listing.name: Guardian Heroes (Xbox Live Arcade) — Guardian Heroes (XBLA) recompilation (rashevskyv)
listing.summary: Upstream reports Linux gameplay and input. Audio has not been checked by listening. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own full 2011 Guardian Heroes Xbox Live Arcade retail package, title ID 58410B2B, or its complete extracted files. Keep the 3178496-byte XEX and matching media folder together.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Linux release archive with your own full XBLA data. The Windows source build currently fails at its final linking step.

warnings: Upstream reports Linux gameplay and input. Audio has not been checked by listening.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
